title: Escalate the Backordered Laptop
subtitle: Resolve a real block with a loaner
scenario: The gate routed this hire to escalation because hardware is blocked. This is the real thing, not a drill: the laptop is backordered to SD+3. Escalate it to the owner with a concrete resolution - issue a loaner - so the hire can start on time.
input: Hire H-4022 is blocked: the Standard laptop is backordered to SD+3. Escalate to the IT Provisioner (owns hardware). The resolution is to issue a loaner laptop by SD-1 so the hire works from day one while the ordered machine ships. Capture the task, owner, and action.
instructions: Choose the resolution action that lets the hire start on time.
Validate to mint the escalation record.

fields.label: Blocked task
fields.explain: Escalate the actually-blocked task - hardware - not one that completed.

fields.label: Escalation owner
fields.explain: Hardware is owned by the IT Provisioner; the escalation goes to whoever can actually resolve it.

fields.label: Resolution
fields.explain: A loaner lets the hire start on time while the ordered laptop ships; delaying the start or waiting fails the day-one goal.

copilotPrompt: Capture a real escalation for a backordered laptop: blocked task hardware, owner IT Provisioner, resolution issue loaner (so the hire starts on time). Route it with an owner and action.
successMessage: Escalation resolved with a loaner. The hire starts on time while the ordered laptop ships.

sections.title: Escalation is problem-solving
sections.body: The gate found the block; escalation fixes it. A good escalation does not just forward the problem - it names an owner and a concrete action that unblocks the start.

sections.title: Own it to resolve it
sections.body: Hardware belongs to the IT Provisioner, so that is where the escalation lands. Sending it to someone who cannot act is how a block sits untouched until the start day.

sections.title: Pick the action that saves day one
sections.body: A loaner keeps the day-one promise; delaying the start or waiting for the backorder breaks it. The best resolution is the one that unblocks the goal, not the easiest one.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A resolved escalation record - task, owner, and loaner action - the degraded package will reference.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd grab a spare laptop for day one and keep the backorder moving, rather than delaying the start.

tools.powerAutomate: create an escalation task to IT with a loaner action and due date
tools.zapier: route the block to IT with the resolution captured
tools.python: open an escalation {task:'hardware', owner:'IT', action:'issue loaner'}

takeaway.heading: Escalation resolved
points: You escalated the real block - hardware - to its owner, the IT Provisioner.
The resolution issues a loaner so the hire starts on time.
You picked the action that saves day one, not the easiest one.
The escalation carries an owner, action, and deadline.
The workflow can now unblock a stuck hire and still hit the start date.
